profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at AVEVA
profile.summary:
I'm currently working as a Senior Software Developer at AVEVA (formerly OSIsoft) designing and maintaining cloud infrastructure. I'm experienced with the .NET Framework, C# Programming, and various Azure services. I'm known for speaking up when issues or tech debt needs to be addressed and coordinating between development and DevOps groups to progress cross-team projects.

I graduated from Arizona State University with a BS in Computer Science, a certificate in Computer Gaming, and was a part of Barrett, the Honors College.

projects.title: Behavior Trees + Finite State Machines: A Hybrid Game AI Framework
projects.description:
One of the core components of many video games is their artificial intelligence. Through AI, a
game can tell stories, generate challenges, and create encounters for the player to overcome.
Even though AI has continued to advance through the implementation of neural networks and
machine learning, game AI tends to implement a series of states or decisions instead to give the
illusion of intelligence. Despite this limitation, games can still generate a wide range of
experiences for the player.

The Hybrid Game AI Framework is an AI system that combines the benefits of two commonly
used approaches to developing game AI: Behavior Trees and Finite State Machines. Developed
in the Unity Game Engine and the C# programming language, this AI Framework represents the
research that went into studying modern approaches to game AI and my own attempt at
implementing the techniques learned. Object-oriented programming concepts such as
inheritance, abstraction, and low coupling are utilized with the intent to create game AI that’s
easy to implement and expand upon. The final goal was to create a flexible yet structured AI data
structure while also minimizing drawbacks by combining Behavior Trees and Finite State
Machines.

This Game AI Framework was developed for my ASU Barrett Honors Creative Project, the final requirement for graduating from Barrett, the Honors College.

projects.title: Chromaslice
projects.description:
Chromaslice is a local multiplayer party-game developed by 25% Games (ASU Video Game Development Club).

During this project, I acted as the Lead Producer of the project. By coordinating with other team leads, I created and maintained a production schedule using Scrum-Agile concepts such as Sprints and retrospectives. Towards the end of the project, I wrote the guidelines for establishing a new Production team to improve production management.

Download our game here:
- https://25percentgames.itch.io/chromaslice
